data.standardized_narrative: The report states that prior closed years ran off satisfactorily and that virtually all prior years produced releases. No explicit gross prior-year reserve movement amount is disclosed in the technical reserves movement note; therefore a quantified gross prior year development is not available from the report. The managing agent attributes the favourable runoff to expected claims development and an absence of major new adverse events; named historical events mentioned include Hurricane Sandy (2012) and MH370 (2014), the latter with a stable loss reserve.

data.data_quality_notes: Report is presented in US Dollars for 2015. No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was found in the 'movement in prior year's provision' note; only qualitative narrative stating releases. Consequently prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. The opening reserves figure is the gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2014 (USD 421,809k) taken from the Statement of Financial Position. A gross claims development triangle is not present; a gross loss-ratio development table is present and used as a claims development reference.
